caseNameFull: Frank N. Hoffstot v. Bernard A. Flood, a Detective of Police of the City of New York
summary: Appeal from the Circuit Court of the United States for the Southern District of New York.
attorneys: Mr. W. A. Blakeley, Mr. Charles S. Whitman, Mr. Warren I. Seymour, Mr. George Gordon Battle and Mr. B. Snowden Marshall for the appellee, in support of the motions., Mr. Adrian H. Joline, Mr. John D. Lindsay and Mr. Adrian JI. Larkin for the appellant, in opposition thereto.

opinions.text: Order affirmed with costs. No further opinion will be delivered. (Mr. Justice Hughes did not participate in the consideration or decision of this case.)
